scenarios.title: A｜主动道歉
scenarios.setting: 争吵结束后，玩家意识到自己刚才说了一些过分的话。

turns.text: Can we talk about what happened earlier?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m sorry for the way I spoke to you. I was upset, but that doesn’t excuse it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry for the way I spoke to you. I was upset, but that doesn’t excuse it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’ve been thinking about what I said, and I shouldn’t have said those things.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been thinking about what I said, and I shouldn’t have said those things.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I was frustrated, but I took it out on you. I’m sorry.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was frustrated, but I took it out on you. I’m sorry.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I still think we need to talk about the problem, but I could have handled it much better.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still think we need to talk about the problem, but I could have handled it much better.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry for the way I spoke to you. I was upset, but that doesn’t excuse it.

choices.text: I’m sorry I hurt you. I’ll try not to react like that again.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry I hurt you. I’ll try not to react like that again.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I mean it. I want to handle things differently next time.

scenarios.title: C｜仍然需要时间
scenarios.setting: 在“道歉与和好”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“仍然需要时间”。
